key: A precision tuner for sixty instruments, with the practice that keeps you in tune.
source: A precision tuner for sixty instruments, with the practice that keeps you in tune.
old: Natančen uglaševalec za šestdeset inštrumentov, z vadbo, ki vas ohranja uglašene.
root_proposed_new: Natančen uglaševalnik za šestdeset glasbil z vadbo za čisto igranje.
new: Natančen uglaševalnik za šestdeset glasbil z vadbo za čisto intonacijo.
reviewer: Codex review_sk (independent Slovenian UI register review)
reason: Keep the source pitch-accuracy promise explicit. Čisto igranje could mean general clean technique; čista intonacija expresses staying in tune and uses the glossary intonation sense.

key: A precision tuner, hundreds of lessons that listen as you play, and a daily quest to keep you going.
source: A precision tuner, hundreds of lessons that listen as you play, and a daily quest to keep you going.
old: Natančen uglaševalec, na stotine lekcij, ki vas poslušajo med igranjem, in dnevni izziv, ki vas ohranja v zagonu.
root_proposed_new: Natančen uglaševalnik, na stotine lekcij, ki poslušajo tvoje igranje, in dnevna naloga za nadaljnji napredek.
new: Natančen uglaševalnik, na stotine lekcij, ki poslušajo tvoje igranje, in dnevna naloga, ki te spodbuja k nadaljevanju.
reviewer: Codex review_sk (independent Slovenian UI register review)
reason: The source daily quest encourages continuation, not an additional promise of further progress. Retain the listening-lesson and precision-tuner facts and informal ti while keeping the persistence meaning.

reviewer: Codex review_sk (independent Slovenian UI register review)
reason: PaywallPlan.swift inserts the localized course title (e.g. Kitara) in dictionary form. Lekcije za Kitara requires a missing accusative ending; prefixing the unchanged value as a nominative heading avoids inflecting an unknown placeholder.

key: You're on a %lld-day streak, and you've practised today.

new: Tvoj %lld-dnevni niz traja, za danes pa je vadba že opravljena.
reviewer: Codex review_sk (independent Slovenian UI register review)
reason: Replace awkward danes pa že šteje vadba with a natural gender-neutral completed-practice statement. StreakSnippet uses this branch only when practicedToday is true; preserve the day placeholder and avoid user-gender agreement.
